sections.content: You know reported questions with *preguntó* and a question word from A2 Unit 14 (*preguntas indirectas*), and *preguntó si* from B1 Unit 27. Use *preguntar si* for a yes/no question and a question word for an information question; the verb moves back one step, as in any report.

items.english: She asked me if I had time.
She asked me where I lived.

items.spanish: El detective preguntó quién había llegado primero.
items.english: The detective asked who had arrived first.

sections.content: A reported question has no question marks, but the question word keeps its accent (*dónde*, *qué*, *quién*), while *si* for a yes/no question has none: *Me preguntó si tenía tiempo*.
